# jobrunner

Small job runner with a configurable bounded exponential retry policy.

## Retry policy

`run_job` accepts a `RetryConfig` and an injected `Sleeper`. The configuration
uses `max_attempts` as the total number of calls, including the initial call.
Only `RetryError::Transient` failures are retried; `RetryError::Permanent`
failures are returned immediately.

After a transient failure, the runner waits for `base_delay_ms`, then doubles
the delay for each subsequent retry. Delays are capped at `max_delay_ms`, and
all waiting is performed through `Sleeper`, so callers can provide a real or
test implementation without changing the `run_job` signature.

     1 | # jobrunner
     2 | 
     3 | Small job runner with a configurable bounded exponential retry policy.
     4 | 
     5 | ## Retry policy
     6 | 
     7 | `run_job` accepts a `RetryConfig` and an injected `Sleeper`. The configuration
     8 | uses `max_attempts` as the total number of calls, including the initial call.
     9 | Only `RetryError::Transient` failures are retried; `RetryError::Permanent`
    10 | failures are returned immediately.
    11 | 
    12 | After a transient failure, the runner waits for `base_delay_ms`, then doubles
    13 | the delay for each subsequent retry. Delays are capped at `max_delay_ms`, and
    14 | all waiting is performed through `Sleeper`, so callers can provide a real or
    15 | test implementation without changing the `run_job` signature.
